contract-ci-contracts
text: - The cold-agent pipe's six apps and its bar: `STAND_PROMPT` names six apps — counter, flight booker, timer, CRUD, cells and the load page — and their goals, still naming no stand id; the live server child runs `mcp --record` into the owner-only `target/cold-agent/record/`, its two replay children without `--record`; `passed` needs, beside the atoms above, every app met from its accepted `snapshot` answers (an app reset on its accepted `start`, a paged screen's parts joined by their latest answers), `lint`, `screenshot` and `advance` each used and a part read (else `capability-unused`), one kept check per accepted `start` (else `recording-not-kept`) and `wrong_calls × 100 ≤ 5 × tool_calls` (else `wrong-calls-over-bar`), the three reasons after `task-unmet` and before the check's; the verdict adds `wrong_call_bar_pct` (5) · `lint_calls` · `screenshot_calls` · `advance_calls` · `part_reads` · `recorded_sessions` · `recording_kept`; the replay's expect match reads a paged answer's decoded text (scripts/cold-agent.sh:19-31; scripts/cold-agent.sh:178-271; scripts/cold-agent.sh:428-506).
